title: DecisionPurpose
description: A decision purpose: one kind of choice a model may help make, the authority class that bounds what any answer can change, and the ordered backends that may answer it (ADR-0015, proposed as a shared contract in ADR-0017). `rules` is always a backend: the deterministic path that off/auto modes and outages fall back to. Source of truth in AnalystOS: src/analystos/decisions/{types,config,authority}.py and the `decisions:` section of config/models.yaml; tests/unit/test_cross_repo_contracts.py keeps this file in step with them.

name.description: Stable purpose id (e.g. ask_route, clarify_needed, alert_triage).

backends.description: Tried in order; the first answer the authority class accepts decides. Must include `rules`.

timeout_seconds.description: Across the purpose's model backends; rules always run inline.

default.description: The value when no backend answers (choice purposes).

min_rounds.description: bounded_stop: nobody may stop before this many rounds.

min_supported.description: bounded_stop: a model may not stop with fewer supported findings.

allOf.description: Rules-first classes: the rule sets the baseline (or the minimum work) before any model is asked.

authority_class.description: What an answer is allowed to change. A proposal outside it is refused and the next backend is tried; no class can grant access, lower a risk, skip a gate or suppress an alert.

oneOf.description: Reorder valid options. A dropped option keeps its rule score; an unknown option is ignored.
Pick one of the rule-valid presentations; anything else is refused.
Pick one of the valid processing paths; anything else is refused. Needs calibration.
Final level = max(baseline, proposal) on an ordered scale. Nothing can lower the baseline.
A stop before min_rounds (or, from a model, before min_supported findings) is refused. Needs calibration.

decision_record.title: DecisionRecord
decision_record.description: What is persisted for every decision (AnalystOS table `decision_record`). `value` is always the enforced answer, never the raw proposal.

proposal.description: The deciding backend's raw answer, before enforcement.

enforced.description: What the authority class changed or refused.

inputs_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON (contracts/approval_hash.md) of {purpose, state, facts, question{kind, instructions, options, hint, levels, baseline}}.

subject.description: What the decision is about, e.g. ask:<turn id>, insight:<id>, alert:<key>.
